artifacts.summary: Re-confirms by content all seven stale anchors in the 901 report are unchanged since task 927's measurement, supplies the complete verbatim work list for six of them, and resolves the one preservation subtlety in the anchor-3 Risks paragraph (the refusal sentence must be appended, not dropped) with the fully merged replacement text.

memory_candidates.content: When applying a prior task's verbatim amendment text to a report, check whether the paragraph being replaced carries a sentence the dispatch separately names as must-preserve (e.g. a standing refusal/scope-limiting clause) that is absent from the replacement text itself. A literal swap silently drops it. The correct application appends the preserved sentence to the end of the replacement text rather than treating the replacement as a full substitute; state the fully merged final text in the research report so the implementation phase performs no further merge.
